shared_rules.healer_targeting: Base support action heals 12 HP on each 1-second completed support action; it replaces the enemy basic attack, never overlaps it. Choose lowest percent-health ally in 3 tiles; Tanker then DPS break ties. No heal on target acquisition, switch or re-entry.
shared_rules.ability_rules: Cooldown begins on release; no self-stacking; no resurrection; buffs require explicit duration; bosses ignore forced movement and hard crowd control unless a specific encounter says otherwise.
shared_rules.social_balance: Recruitment origin changes story, materials and training expression; base combat budgets are equal across origins. Village recruits are not weaker than noble recruits.
shared_rules.concept_status: All sprite frame counts, poses and effects below are specifications for artists; no claim of playable implementation.
shared_rules.target_caps: Every ability contains explicit per-cast enemy/ally caps. All healing/damage-over-time effects have bounded ticks and total output; re-entry does not reset a budget. All shields expire at their stated duration and never generate healing unless explicitly stated. Positive modifiers do not stack with another copy of the same named ability.
